title: NRCan-StatCan-Utility-Research
summary: A research repository for generating synthetic utility time-series data as part of a Natural Resources Canada / Statistics Canada pipeline, using Docker-based synthetic data generator images and notebooks for preprocessing, training, and evaluation. It runs SDV's PARSynthesizer (sequential/PAR model) to train and sample synthetic time-series data and evaluate it against real data.
needs: Government affiliation (NRCan/StatCan) implied by repo name but no named authors or byline given in README
